attributes.name: Dismissal
attributes.powers: For your check to defeat a bane that has the Outsider trait, discard this card to use your Arcane or Divine skill + 2d8 plus the scenario's adventure deck number.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane 12 or Divine 10 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.

corrections.corrected_text: On the spell Dismissal, change "use your Arcane or Divine skill + 2d8 plus the scenario’s adventure deck number" to "discard this card to use your Arcane or Divine skill + 2d8 plus the scenario’s adventure deck number".
corrections.issue: If I play Dismissal on my combat check, do I have to do anything with the card?
